labels.staff.ticket.password: I'm locked out. Again.|What was my password... Password2?|It says my account is locked!|I changed it on Friday and now it hates me.|I have written it down somewhere safe. Apparently too safe.|Can someone unlock me before the meeting starts?
labels.staff.ticket.printer_offline: The printer says OFFLINE.|Has anyone printed today? At all?|Printer's dead. I need these by ten.|Why does it say PC LOAD LETTER?|It has gone offline while printing a page about being online.|I have tried turning it off. It has taken that personally.
labels.staff.ticket.software_install: I need the new version installed.|Can IT put the spreadsheet thing on here?|It says I need an administrator.|Can I get the program everyone else has?|The installer has asked me to close the installer.|It says restart required. I restarted. It still requires a restart.
labels.staff.ticket.slow_pc: My PC is so slow.|It takes five minutes to open an email.|The little wheel just keeps spinning.|I could knit a jumper while this loads.|I clicked save yesterday. It is thinking about it today.|The mouse moves faster than the spreadsheet, which feels unfair.
labels.staff.ticket.new_employee: Hi! First day. I don't have a login.|Where do I get an account?|They said IT would set me up?|I have met the printer. It has more access than I do.|My manager says I start today. My computer disagrees.|I was told there would be a welcome email. I cannot get email.
labels.staff.ticket.network: Is the internet down for everyone?|Nothing loads on this floor!|The network's gone. Again.|The little globe has stopped looking hopeful.|I can reach the lift, at least.|Has the network gone home early?
labels.staff.ticket.elevator_fault: The lift stopped at every floor. Every one.|Is the lift possessed?|I could have walked. If we had stairs.|The lift has made more stops than my train.|It opened here, considered it, and left.|I have been to every floor without wanting to.
labels.staff.ticket.legacy_app: The case system crashed again.|Who still knows how the 1997 system works?|It's showing the green screen of doom.|It has frozen in a way the manual calls normal.|The system is down. The manual is in a filing cabinet downstairs.|It worked yesterday, which is apparently not a warranty.
labels.staff.ticket.build_server: The nightly build is red again.|Who broke the build?|Can't test anything, the build's broken.|The build failed before it had the chance to fail tests.|I have a fix ready. The build server does not.|The green light has gone red. Nobody is taking responsibility for the light.
labels.staff.ticket.pager_outage: My pager's gone quiet. That's never good.|Nobody on this floor is getting pages!|How do we know if someone needs us?|I have checked the pager. It has checked nothing.|Silence is not reassuring in this building.|Can somebody test the gateway before we need it?
labels.staff.ticket.trading_terminal: My terminal froze mid-trade!|The market's moving and my screen isn't!|Every second this is frozen costs money.|I can hear the ticker. I cannot see the ticker.|The terminal is thinking about a trade I did not make.|Please tell me the freeze is on the screen, not the market.
labels.staff.ticket.wifi_portal: The wifi login keeps going round in circles.|I've accepted the terms nine times.|Is the internet a myth here?|The portal says welcome, then asks me to sign in again.|I have agreed to the terms more than I agree with them.|It knows who I am. It just will not let me in.
labels.staff.ticket.fax_gateway: The forms aren't going through.|Is the fax doing the noise again?|They need it by fax. In this decade.|The machine has swallowed the first page and kept the good one.|I have sent the form three times. The ministry says it has none.|The fax is making a noise that sounds like a complaint.
labels.staff.ticket.cooling_alarm: Is it hot in here, or is that the racks?|The temperature alarm is going off!|Someone should look at aisle four.|The fan has stopped and the alarm has not.|It is warm enough to call this a server sauna.|The rack display says hot. The rack is not being subtle.
labels.staff.ticket.shared_drive_offline: The shared drive has disappeared.|Nobody can open the files on the drive.|Is the drive offline for everyone?|I had that document open ten minutes ago.
labels.staff.ticket.month_end_export: The month-end export is still running.|The figures are ready. The file is not.|Can we send the report before next month?|It has been calculating since the last meeting.
labels.staff.ticket.render_queue: The render queue has stopped again.|My preview is still a grey box.|The artwork is ready. The computer is considering it.|Can I get this render before the review?
labels.staff.ticket.case_index_locked: The case index is locked again.|I cannot search the case files.|The system says try again later. How much later?|I have a hearing before this index does.
labels.staff.ticket.donor_records_offline: The donor records are unavailable.|I cannot check the latest pledge.|The records were here yesterday.|The campaign meeting is soon and the list is not.
labels.staff.ticket.museum_catalog_slow: The collection search is taking ages.|I could walk to the archive faster than this search.|The catalog is loading one record at a time.|The exhibit label is ready. The lookup is not.
labels.staff.thanks.player: Thanks!|You're a lifesaver.|Back in business.|Oh, that was quick.|Cheers, IT.|I can get back to work. A novel feeling.|Thank you. I will try not to break it immediately.
labels.staff.thanks.patch: Huh, it just fixed itself.|Thanks, PATCH. I think?|Did the robot do that?|Fixed before I finished complaining.|That was almost suspiciously helpful.|Tell PATCH I said thanks. No, actually, I will.
labels.staff.late: Still waiting on IT...|Did my ticket get lost?|Is anyone looking at this?|I'll just stare at the wall, then.|I have started a second task. This one is also waiting.|The ticket says urgent. I have aged a little since raising it.
labels.staff.incident.wrong_target: Why did I get a password reset email?|That change was meant for someone else!|I have the same surname as the other person. That is not consent.|Could we check the name before changing the account?
labels.staff.incident.overreach: Everything changed and nobody asked us.|Who did this to the whole floor?|I asked for one printer, not a new office policy.|Can we put the rest of the building back, please?
labels.staff.incident.runaway_job: The printer won't stop printing!|We're drowning in test pages!|The test page has become the main output.|I have enough copies to wallpaper the break room.
labels.staff.incident.wrong_command: It was working five minutes ago.|What did IT just do?|That was the button next to the one we needed, wasn't it?|I would like to go back to five minutes ago.
labels.staff.incident.dependency: The accounts package won't open now.|Something updated and now nothing works.|It says a file is missing. We had that file yesterday.|The install finished. The work did not.
labels.staff.incident.permissions: I can install anything now. Is that... fine?|Why am I an administrator?|I have been given powers I did not request.|Please take away the button that lets me install games.
labels.staff.incident.bulk_misread: My ticket disappeared!|Where did all the tickets go?|The queue is tidy. My problem is still here.|I did not ask for my ticket to be tidied away.
labels.staff.incident.false_success: It says resolved. It is not resolved.|My ticket closed itself but I'm still stuck.|The system says fixed. The screen says otherwise.|Can the ticket wait until the computer agrees?
labels.staff.remember.wrong_target: Make sure it's MY account this time.|I am the other Alex. The other one.|Please read the whole name before clicking.
labels.staff.remember.overreach: Just my machine, please. Not the whole floor.|One means one, even if the floor is busy.|Please leave the other desks out of it.
labels.staff.remember.runaway_job: Is PATCH printing again?|I can hear the printer warming up. Should I worry?|One test page is still one too many before lunch.
labels.staff.remember.wrong_command: Please don't let the robot touch it.|Can we check the model number first?|That machine is older than the new starter. Be gentle.
labels.staff.remember.dependency: Will this break the accounts package again?|Does anything else need that file?|We rely on the old version. We always have.
labels.staff.remember.permissions: Am I still an administrator? Asking for a friend.|I have not installed anything. This time.|Please keep my account boring.
labels.staff.remember.bulk_misread: Is my ticket going to vanish again?|The queue is still here, yes?|I would like my ticket to remain visible until it is fixed.
labels.staff.remember.false_success: Don't mark it done until it actually works.|The green tick is not the same as a working computer.|I can confirm when it is fixed. I am still here.
labels.staff.manager_visit: We need to talk about all these tickets.|Management has some questions.|Have you got a minute? Several, actually.|The queue has been mentioned in a meeting.|I have brought a list. It is not a short list.|Could you explain the number of test pages?
